purpose: A fail-closed arithmetic kernel for the 13-by-20 tonalpohualli cycle. It does not supply a default civil-date correlation or any divinatory meaning.

source_anchors.location: folio 1r, stable folio id afbf3a94-1f97-4bb5-bb75-d15fdb97ef40; canvas d1b1deca-1a34-4947-a20a-8b9a8cb6810c
source_anchors.verified_claim: The Spanish-to-English text states that thirteen-day periods make a 260-day cycle and return to the beginning; the Nahuatl and Spanish headings begin with Ce Cipactli.

source_anchors.location: Anales del Museo Nacional, table of the twenty trecenas, scan pages numbered 89 and 521 in indexed witnesses
source_anchors.verified_claim: The table supplies the complete twenty-sign order, the coefficient permutation across trecenas, and the 260-position recurrence. Historical spellings are retained as source labels.

cycle.advance_rule: For integer day offset d from a valid anchor, advance the coefficient and day-sign indices independently modulo 13 and 20.
cycle.trecena_rule: Coefficient 1 begins a trecena; the coefficient is also the one-based position within that trecena.

epoch_contract.supported_date_input: An ISO civil date already resolved under the named calendar, locality and day-boundary profile.
unsupported_inputs: A clock instant requiring unresolved timezone or day-boundary conversion
A Maya correlation reused because both systems have 260-day cycles
